scene:visible_bubble_shooter_board.object_description: a close-packed bubble-shooter board with colored bubbles, a marked landing target, and a visible launcher area

query:pop_count.bubble_shooter_rule_text: A shot bubble attaches at the marked target. A same-color connected group pops when the placed bubble makes that group size at least three. Do not count the shot bubble or the marked target itself.
query:pop_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the number of existing board bubbles that pop
query:pop_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of pixel-space center points [x, y] for the existing board bubbles that pop

query:drop_count.bubble_shooter_rule_text: A shot bubble attaches at the marked target. Same-color connected bubbles pop when the placed bubble makes that group size at least three; then bubbles no longer connected to the top drop.
query:drop_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the number of bubbles that drop after the shot is resolved
query:drop_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of pixel-space center points [x, y] for the bubbles that drop

query:pop_color_label.bubble_shooter_rule_text: A shot bubble attaches at the marked target. A same-color connected group pops when the placed bubble makes that group size at least three.
query:pop_color_label.answer_hint: set "answer" to the single option label whose color would make bubbles pop
query:pop_color_label.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array of pixel-space center points [x, y] for the existing board bubbles that would pop for the selected option
